corrections.subject: angular_peak_amplitude
corrections.issue: Previous text loosely characterized angular peaks as '< 0.09 rad'
corrections.authoritative_finding: The actual peak angular amplitude across the 3 resolutions in the zero-spin case reaches 0.09473341 rad on fine (DP=0.0125) yaw, which exceeds 0.09 rad.

corrections.subject: orientation_rmse_scaling
corrections.issue: Previous text loosely claimed sub-degree absolute orientation accuracy across all comparisons
corrections.authoritative_finding: Maximum absolute orientation RMSE reaches 0.06269848 rad (3.59 degrees) on fine vs coarse yaw, which is not sub-degree. The frozen 5% relative RMSE macro operator remains unchanged; no retroactive threshold relaxations are permitted.

corrections.subject: initial_angular_node_velocity_propagation
corrections.issue: General update kernel propagation alone does not establish GenCase particle velocities
corrections.authoritative_finding: GenCase stores the body initial angular velocity in XML (<execution><particles><floating><angularvelini x='0.08' y='0.12' z='0.06' units_comment='rad/s'/>) while particle velocities in the initial GenCase BI4 remain zero. Particle velocity propagation (vr = v_lin + omega x dist) is performed by the DualSPHysics solver at initialization (JSph.cpp:1162 loading fomega and FtPartsUpdate in JSphCpuSingle.cpp:1084-1086 / JSphGpu_ker.cu:2049-2051). Verification of particle initial velocities requires inspecting actual solver Frame 0 (Part_0000.bi4), not GenCase alone.

corrections.subject: prospective_excitation_status
corrections.issue: Prospective 3D excitation must not be represented as an established cure or guaranteed convergence
corrections.authoritative_finding: The prospective angular release excitation vector [0.08, 0.12, 0.06] rad/s is an UNTESTED HYPOTHESIS. It provides a physically motivated macroscopic excitation candidate, but convergence and conditioning under the frozen 5% macro operator can only be evaluated from future solver results.

corrections.subject: chaos_and_horizon_claims
corrections.issue: Unmeasured claims of measured chaos or Lyapunov horizon
corrections.authoritative_finding: All claims of measured chaos, Lyapunov horizon, or 12 corners (geometry is 8 corners and 12 edges) are retracted. Neither 1-DOF heave constraint nor shortened 3s window is accepted; the full 12s unconstrained free 6DOF candidate is preserved.
